people.imagined: A karst cave mouth at dusk. She has stopped on the threshold of an abode wall covered in old brush-strokes and tilts her head as if the wall had spoken. A silver needle holds her hair, and her pleasant face is entirely calm.
people.subject: The moment: dusk at the mouth of a karst cave, she has stopped on the threshold of an abode whose wall is covered in old brush-strokes and tilts her head as if the wall had spoken. Face: a tall woman's long, quiet, pleasant face with soft features, smooth pale skin, a high forehead, straight even brows, large dark attentive eyes and a gentle full mouth in a small kind smile; nothing in it is cruel, which is the point. Hair: glossy black, coiled high and held by one long silver needle with a plain round head, a few fine strands drifting in the dusk haze. Body: tall, straight and slender, hands folded, a patient stillness. Clothing: three layers of heavy silk in a dark red that has aged to the colour of old liver, the crossed collars each a shade apart, wide sleeves falling in long folds, the borders embroidered in black thread with slow curling shadow-clouds; a plain sash of matching silk hung with one dark jade pendant, an outer veil of smoke-grey gauze over the shoulders; the richness of a master's last disciple, immaculate and weighty. Hands and objects: both hands folded before her waist, slim, with short clean nails; a silver ring with a plain flat top on the right forefinger. Background: grey karst rock and the black mouth of a cave, drifting violet-grey mist, blurred. Light: low cool dusk light from the upper left with a pale silver rim along her hair and shoulder, and a faint warm red from her robe on her chin. Power: a Kết Đan cultivator, so a soft aura of dark teal Water-and-shadow lies round her hands, thin wisps curling like ink in water and a few dim motes rising. Expression: courteous calm, listening. Palette: liver red, silver, grey stone, teal shadow.

people.imagined: The night in the year 700, in his study: a fine copyist's son with a thin brush in his hand, his master's cut hair in a bundle on the desk. He is perfectly composed, and has just finished binding hair into the brush.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; on the night in the year 700 a fastidious scholar sits at his writing desk in his study, holding up a long thin brush and examining its tip with cool satisfaction after binding hair into it. Face: a long, refined, pale face with a high forehead, a long thin nose, thin lips pressed in a small patient smile, deep-set dark eyes with an unwavering courteous gaze, thin well-groomed brows and a thin trimmed black beard on the chin; about fifty. Hair: black, combed tight into a high topknot held by a black lacquer crown with a slim jet pin. Body: slender, straight-backed, long-necked, elegant stillness. Clothing: the layered robes of a ma đạo master of great standing, an inner robe of black silk with a high crossed collar, a second of deep crimson, and an outer gown of black gauze with dark-red lining at the cuffs and collar edge, wide sleeves in perfect folds, the borders embroidered with fine crimson brush-strokes and drifting clouds; a sash of dark red cord with a black jade pendant. Hands and objects: in the right hand a long thin brush with a long grey hair tip, held upright; on the desk a small dark ink stone, a bundle of long white hair tied with red thread, a shallow bowl of dark red liquid and a single silver needle laid across the wood. Background: dark study shelves of unmarked scrolls, blurred in drifting incense mist. Light: one lamp from the upper left, warm, with a faint cold spirit-light along the brush, the whole picture aged and softened. Power: a faint dark crimson glow gathers along the brush and a few crimson motes hang over the desk. Expression: a thin courteous smile that never reaches the eyes, the gaze resting on the brush tip with cool satisfaction. Palette: black, dark red, aged yellow.

people.imagined: At the mouth of U Lan Cốc in the small hours, a clay lamp burning on a ledge for the children. She has just stepped out to look at it and speaks softly, as if someone in the next room were asleep.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of U Lan Cốc in the small hours she stands beside a small clay lamp on a rock ledge, set out for the children, and speaks in a hush as if someone in the next room were asleep, a finger half raised to her lips. Face: a thin, quiet, tired face of about forty with high cheekbones, pale skin, large soft grey eyes with shadows under them, thin level brows, a straight nose and a gentle mouth almost always in a half-smile of attention. Hair: thick dark brown in a loose low braid with a few grey strands, tied with a pale grey silk ribbon and one small jade comb. Body: thin and narrow, shoulders drawn slightly in, a gentle stoop. Clothing: a gown of fine grey silk in two layers with crossed collars, the outer one of soft grey gauze that stirs in the gorge air, long sleeves whose cuffs are stained deep grey with years of ground ink yet clean, borders embroidered in silvery thread with small orchid sprigs; a plain sash hung with a pale stone carrying a tiny flower fossil, on a thin cord at her throat. Hands and objects: ink-grey fingertips clearly visible, one hand raised; a small clay lamp with a steady yellow flame on the ledge beside her. Background: dark limestone gorge walls, wet moss and a faint pale orchid on the rock, blurred in mist. Light: the small warm lamp from the lower right, cool silver moonlight and grey dark elsewhere, a soft rim light on her braid. Power: a Kết Đan keeper, so a thin violet-blue Water-and-shadow haze rises round the lamp and her raised hand, with a few pale motes drifting upward. Expression: soft, watchful, protective. Palette: grey, lamp amber, deep teal, violet.

people.imagined: A wind-bitten rock ledge on Hắc Ưng Peak, dusk. He sits with a heavy sabre across his knees, having just watched a climber turn back, waiting without any hurry for the next, the corners of his beard stained rust brown.
people.subject: The moment: dusk on a wind-bitten rock ledge of Hắc Ưng Peak, he sits with a heavy sabre across his knees, having just watched a climber turn back, waiting without any hurry for the next. Face: a broad, heavy-jawed grey man's face with deep furrows, a thick flattened nose, small hard grey eyes under heavy brows and a thick grey beard whose corners at the mouth are stained a dull rust brown, the most important mark; about fifty-five. Hair: iron grey and long, gathered tight at the nape and held by a dark iron crown-clasp. Body: broad, thick-shouldered, heavy-chested, a sitting bulk like a boulder. Clothing: a long robe in layers of dark brown and iron-grey silk with crossed collars and wide cuffs that fall to the knee, the borders embroidered in rust thread with stooping eagle-wings, a dark gauze mantle across the shoulders stirring in the wind, a black sash hung with a plain iron-grey jade ring; the robes of a Kết Đan duelist, severe and costly. Hands and objects: both big scarred hands rest on a heavy single-edged sabre in a plain black scabbard with an iron guard, laid across his knees, the right thumb on the guard. Background: a wind-scoured cliff of dark red-brown rock, drifting cloud, the shape of an eagle far off in a pale sky, blurred. Light: cold low light from the upper left, a rust glow on the rock and a pale silver rim along his beard and shoulder. Power: a soft steel-grey Metal glint hovers along the scabbard and thin grey motes streak past him in the wind, a faint warm red-brown Fire flush at the edge of the blade. Expression: flat, patient, unhurried, a mouth that might smile. Palette: iron grey, rust brown, cold sky.

people.imagined: A dry riverbed town at noon. He holds his gourd at his side and does not drink, because a villager is watching the well. He turns his whole body so that no one sees him lift it.
people.subject: The moment: noon at a dry village well, he stands with his gourd held down at his side, deliberately not drinking, glancing at the unseen people who watch, so that no one sees him lift it. Face: a dry, tidy old man's face, narrow and sun-leathered, deep vertical lines in the cheeks, thin pressed lips, small sharp dark eyes, thin grey brows and a neat close-trimmed grey beard; about sixty-five. Hair: thin white-grey, tied up neatly in a small black gauze cap with a plain dark jade pin. Body: lean, upright, dry, stiff. Clothing: a long robe of fine brown-grey silk in three layers, the crossed collars edged in pale grey, narrow sleeves under a loose outer gauze of ash colour, the borders embroidered with faint wave and well-ring motifs in dull green thread; a neat dark sash with a jade disc, a folded travelling cloak of pale silk over one arm; the plain but costly dress of an old Kết Đan hermit. Hands and objects: a small round gourd on a cord, stoppered with wood, bitter-brown, held in the right hand against his hip; the left hand on the stone rim of a dry stone well. Background: a stone well with a rope, a dusty village lane of low houses, hazy and blurred. Light: hard pale spirit-light standing in for noon from the upper left, a short sharp shadow beside the well curb, a faint silver rim on his cap, and the gourd's bitter brown glinting dully. Power: a thin dark-teal Water mist pools in the well's shadow and a few cool blue motes cling to the gourd. Expression: patient, watchful, utterly composed with a hint of old grievance. Palette: brown-grey, stone, dull green, teal.

people.imagined: Dawn, the last well of Tình Sa. She stands at the lip with a bundle of bitter-root tied to her chest, a young woman looking down into the dark water, afraid and not turning back.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; at dawn at the last well of Tình Sa a young woman stands at the stone lip with a bundle of bitter root tied to her chest, looking down into the dark water, afraid and not turning back. Face: a young, plain, brave face of about twenty-seven with a square jaw, strong brows drawn together, dark steady eyes, a straight nose and lips pressed tight in fear and resolve. Hair: black, in a single plain braid pinned up and bound with a strip of white cloth, one loose lock lifting in the draught from the well. Body: sturdy and strong-armed, a well-keeper's frame, upright. Clothing: a mortal's dress, plain but clean and gracefully cut, a long robe of undyed pale linen with a crossed collar and a second lighter layer showing at the neck, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a sash of twisted white rope; no ornament except a thin sprig of green embroidered at the hem; across her chest a bundle of long knotted dried roots tied with cord. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the rough stone lip of a round well, knuckles white; a rope and a wooden bucket beside her; the roots hanging bitter brown at her chest. Background: a round stone well and a river village at dawn, soft mist rising from the water, blurred. Light: pale grey-silver dawn light from the upper left, a thin pewter thread on the water far below, the whole picture aged and softened. Power: none, she is a mortal; only a faint green-brown Wood shimmer clings to the roots, as if the bitterness itself were a spirit. Expression: frightened and set, lips tight, eyes fixed on the dark below. Palette: faded grey, root brown, pale green.

people.imagined: A road between the sects in the year he taught his one student. A wandering man with a pack on his back sits on a stone, quite proud, a small brush in his hand, writing out a talisman for someone who will pay.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; on a road between the sects in the year he taught his one student, a wandering talisman master sits on a roadside stone, writing a talisman for someone who will pay and smiling with pride at the page. Face: a thin, lively, weathered face, long and brown, with deep laugh lines, bright dark eyes, bushy grey eyebrows, a long straight nose, a wide smiling mouth and a thin white beard; about fifty-eight. Hair: long grey hair in a loose topknot with a strip of pale blue silk and a plain bone pin, a few strands blowing in the road wind. Body: lean and wiry, a little bent from the road. Clothing: the free dress of a roving immortal, a long robe of blue-grey silk dusted at the hem but cleanly cut, with two crossed collars of paler blue, wide sleeves that ride the wind, borders embroidered with faint cinnabar cloud-curls, a loose travelling cloak of pale gauze, a silk cord belt hung with two small gourds and a jade tassel; a straw hat on his back. Hands and objects: a brush with a long grey tip in the right hand, a small portable writing board on the left knee with a strip of blank yellow paper, a small ink pot; a bag of paper strips at his side. Background: a dusty road and a distant range under drifting cloud, blurred. Light: warm gold afternoon spirit-light from the upper left with a soft rim on his white beard, the whole picture aged and softened. Power: a faint red cinnabar glow gathers at the brush tip and a few red motes lift off the yellow paper. Expression: bright, trusting pleasure in his own good stroke, eyes crinkled over the page. Palette: faded blue-grey, yellow paper, cinnabar red.

people.imagined: A river landing in the morning. A gold-washer's pan on his back, he waits for his master to speak, three letters sewn into his coat, hoping for once to be asked to sit down.
people.subject: The moment: a river landing in the morning, he stands with hands clasped, waiting for his master to speak, a shallow gold-washer's pan slung on his back, hoping for once to be asked to sit down. Face: a sunburned river man's open face of about thirty-five with high cheeks, narrow dark eyes crinkled from squinting, a straight nose peeling at the tip, a wide mouth that wants to smile and a light stubble. Hair: black and short, tied with a band of red silk. Body: strong and lean, shoulders squared, a boatman's balance. Clothing: a disciple's robe of dark blue-green silk in two layers, the crossed collars edged in paler teal, long sleeves bound at the wrist, a cord sash hung with a small jade fish; at the lapel three white paper corners of letters show where they are sewn in; trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet; clean and finely made, a disciple's version of his master's house of dark crimson and smoke. Hands and objects: a wide shallow iron pan hung across the back by a silk strap, its rim visible over both shoulders; hands clasped before him, a small silver ring on one finger. Background: a wide brown river and reeds, a landing stage, a heron standing in the shallows, rising mist, blurred. Light: low gold morning light from the upper left, glitter on the water and a soft silver rim on his stubble. Power: a thin pale blue Water mist curls round his clasped hands and a few cool motes drift off the river. Expression: waiting, hopeful, eyes lowered to his master out of frame. Palette: river brown, blue-green, gold.

people.imagined: Night at the gorge. She cannot sit still. She stands at the edge of the lamplight with heavy-lidded eyes that are never tired, looking south, thinking of the Tower, restless and not yet ashamed.
people.subject: The moment: night at the gorge, she cannot sit still; at the edge of the lamplight she looks away over her shoulder toward the south, thinking of the Tower, restless and not yet ashamed. Face (most important: heavy-lidded, never-tired eyes): a sharp, raftsman's-daughter's face of about thirty-five, sun-brown, with prominent cheekbones, heavy-lidded dark eyes that never seem to rest, a small straight nose and a firm mouth with a tiny curl of impatience. Hair: black, in a thick high ponytail bound with a grey-green silk cord and a thin silver clasp, a few loose strands across the face. Body: wiry and restless, her weight on the balls of her feet, shoulders a little forward as if ready to walk off at any moment. Clothing: a close-cut gown of grey-green fine silk with two crossed collars, narrow sleeves under a sheer smoke-grey over-robe that trails like mist, borders embroidered in dark thread with small gorge-lamps and ropes, a braided cord belt with a jade bead; neat and elegant. Hands and objects: a long silver needle, thin as a hair and as long as her hand, held between two fingers point down; in her other hand a coil of raft-rope bracelet that keeps twisting. Background: a thin string of small clay lamps along the gorge floor, a rope ladder hanging from a ledge, and far above a thin strip of stars, blurred in mist. Light: cool starlight and a thread of pale moonlight from the upper left on her cheekbone, the lamps' warm edge on one cheek. Power: a faint dark violet shadow gathers at her fingertips with a few dim motes. Expression: hungry, restless eyes pulled away from the camp, a mouth tight with impatience. Palette: grey-green, black, lamp amber, violet.

people.imagined: A night in the gorge. He sits by a small lamp with a ledger of plain paper, making his nightly entry about who went out. Lime dust whitens the backs of his hands, which he never wipes.
people.subject: The moment: night in the gorge, he sits by a small lamp with a bound notebook on a board across his lap, writing carefully with a frown, making his nightly entry about who went out. Face: a plain, earnest, square face of about thirty-eight with a firm jaw, level brown eyes under straight thick brows, a broad nose, a closed mouth, and a pale line of lime dust on one cheek. Hair: black and cropped short, a little untidy, a few grey-white flecks of lime dust above the left ear. Body: stocky and solid, sitting upright on a low stool with one knee bent, a lime-burner's shoulders. Clothing: a disciple's robe of pale undyed silk in two layers, the crossed collar edged in ochre, long sleeves rolled to the wrist, borders embroidered with small earth-brown tally marks, a wide cord belt with a jade bead; clean, plain by choice, and finer than any hemp. Hands and objects: the backs of both hands powder-white with lime dust all the way to the wrist, plainly visible; a brush held upright; a bound notebook of plain paper on his knee; a pale stone pendant on a cord. Background: a dark gorge cave, the wall behind him hung with a row of small slates scratched with tally marks, a bundle of dry herbs on a peg, blurred. Light: a small lamp from the lower right, warm on the hands, its soft glow throwing his shadow huge and still on the cave roof, with a faint silver rim on his hair. Power: a faint ochre Earth glow gathers on the lime dust of his hands and a few golden-brown motes settle on the page. Expression: a stubborn frown of concentration, tired eyes fixed on the line he is writing. Palette: lime white, grey, lamp amber, ochre.

people.imagined: A pill stall in Tinh Hán Thành at midday. She counts coins into her palm, one ear notched where a chain caught it, and smells of iron and cloves, and has just named a higher price than yesterday.
people.subject: The moment: midday at a pill stall in Tinh Hán Thành, she counts coins from a stranger into her palm and has just named a higher price than yesterday. Face (most important: the notched left ear): a hard, pretty, weathered face of about forty with sharp cheekbones, narrow black eyes, a flat nose, a thin practical mouth, tanned skin, and the left ear visibly notched with a bite-sized V cut from its rim where a chain once caught it. Hair: black, in a tight coiled braid wrapped round the head and bound with a strip of rust-red silk and a plain iron hairpin, a few short strands standing at the crown. Body: strong and compact, shoulders broad, one hand always near the sabre. Clothing: a long fitted robe of dark brown silk in two layers with crossed collars, the borders embroidered in rust thread with hammer-and-flame scrolls, a small collar of fine iron-grey scale-silk at the neck, a red silk sash tied at the waist, wide sleeves bound at the wrist; a fighter's dress made graceful, not an apron or leather. Hands and objects: a handful of coins in the left palm; before her on a cloth a flat box of small dark-red pills in rows, a short curved sword hanging at her side. Background: the stone arch of a city market with crowds and hanging lanterns, blurred. Light: bright pale spirit-light from the upper left, the pills glinting like small dark gems, a silver rim on her cheek. Power: a faint steel-grey Metal glint runs along the sword hilt and a few iron-bright motes flicker at her hand. Expression: a flat, cold gaze on the stranger's coins, mouth pressed thin. Palette: rust, umber, brick, iron grey.

people.imagined: On a river bank at the Hungry Ghost festival at dusk. She lifts the small green bell on her wrist and rings it once, over the water, and watches a thin thread of light go from the lamp and out across the river.
people.subject: The moment: on a river bank at the Hungry Ghost festival at dusk, she lifts the small green bell on her wrist, rings it once over the water and watches a thin thread of light go from the lamp and out across the river. Face: a neat, narrow, gentle face of about forty with high cheekbones, tidy brows, clear dark eyes that follow something over the water, a small mouth just parted, and a smudge of ink on one cheek. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a plain wooden pin and a green jade bead, a loose strand blowing across her temple which she leaves. Body: slight, upright and neat, her breath held as if waiting to hear something arrive. Clothing: a robe of brown-green silk in three layers with crossed collars, narrow sleeves whose cuffs are stained with ink, a drifting outer veil of dusk-green gauze, borders embroidered in pale thread with small hanging bells and lotus petals, a cord belt with a jade tassel; very tidy. Hands and objects: on the right wrist a small bell of green bronze on a cord; in the left hand a black bronze lamp with nine small wick holes, glowing faintly like a coal; ink stains clear on both cuffs. Background: a wide dark river with small floating paper lanterns, a dusk sky, blurred in mist. Light: dusk blue with small warm lantern glows from the lower left, the lanterns drifting on the water as dots of gold, a silver moon-rim on her hair. Power: a pale green and silver ripple of sound spreads from the bell and a few pale motes follow the thread of light over the water. Expression: eyes wide and solemn, lips parted in a tender, half-afraid hush. Palette: bell green, lamp gold, dusk blue.

people.imagined: A rainy inn corner in Thu Trì Thành at night. He sits with his back to the wall facing the door, a ledger of faces open under his hand, watching every person who comes in.
people.subject: The moment: a rainy inn corner in Thu Trì Thành at night, he sits with his back to the wall facing the door, a ledger of faces closed under his hand, watching every person who comes in over its top. Face: a thin, dry, pale face of about forty-five with a high narrow forehead, deep-set black eyes that never blink, a thin hooked nose, thin lips drawn tight and a close dark moustache. Hair: black, plastered flat with the comb-lines showing, in a tight small knot under a black gauze cap with a jet pin. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, held stiff and wary. Clothing: a heavy rain-cloak of oiled black silk with a high collar over a dark grey layered robe, two crossed collars visible, narrow sleeves, borders embroidered in dark thread with small rain-clouds, a small brass clasp and a black jade pendant on the sash; nicely fitted and costly. Hands and objects: a thick small book bound in black with a red cord on the table, one hand flat on it; a coin held between two fingers of the other; a cup of tea untouched. Background: a dim inn wall of dark wood, a paper lantern, rain on the window, blurred. Light: a single lantern from the upper left with deep shadow under the eyes, grey streaks of rain-light moving across the black cloak, a cold silver rim on his cap. Power: a thin dark teal Water mist gathers round the hand on the book and cool blue motes bead on the cloak. Expression: eyes fixed on the door, cold and measuring, the thin mouth drawn hard. Palette: black, rain grey, a point of red, teal.

people.imagined: A grove of dead trees in the swamp where each tree stands for a patient. He walks between them with his green-stained hands clasped behind his back, quite at ease, the hair of a clever old man.
people.subject: The moment: a grove of dead trees in the swamp where each tree stands for a patient; he walks between them with his green-stained hands clasped behind his back, looking up at a trunk with cool, mild interest. Face (most important: green-stained hands): a long, thin, handsome old face of about sixty-five with high cheekbones, deep furrows, pale cold eyes, thin white brows, a thin proud mouth with a condescending twist and a white pointed beard. Hair: white and long, in a high knot with a pale jade pin. Body: tall, thin and upright, the green-stained fingers showing behind him. Clothing: layered robes of fine pale-grey silk with stiff crossed collars, an outer gown of translucent grey gauze whose green hem is stained from the swamp, wide sleeves, borders embroidered in silver-green thread with creeping vines, a black sash and a loose cloak; the richness of an alchemist of standing, clean and costly. Hands and objects: the clasped hands, wrists and fingers stained bright green to the knuckles, clearly visible; a small bronze censer on a chain at his belt trailing a green thread of smoke; a few green drops fall from his sleeve. Background: grey swamp mist with rows of bare dead trees, each with a small bundle tied to a low branch, blurred. Light: cold grey diffused spirit-light from the upper left, the wet black bark of the nearest trunk shining faintly, a pale rim on his white hair. Power: a faint green-yellow Wood haze curls from the censer smoke and a few sickly green motes drift between the trees. Expression: a lifted chin and a mild curious gaze at the trunk, one thin brow raised. Palette: pale grey, poison green, black.

people.imagined: The night shrine room of a good Hòe Âm house. She stands carrying her son's lamp in both hands, one wrist bandaged. There is a hairline crack in the clay of the lamp, and she is holding it extremely gently.
people.subject: The moment: in the night shrine room of a good Hòe Âm house, she carries her son's lamp in both hands in front of her chest and looks down at it with a mother's devotion; a hairline crack runs up the clay of the lamp and she holds it extremely gently. Face: a pale, upright, refined face of about thirty-eight, from a good family, with a delicate chin, level dark eyes red at the rims from sleeplessness, fine brows and a thin mouth held steady. Hair: black, in a neat high knot with a pair of white jade pins and a thin white ribbon. Body: slender, straight, held very still. Clothing: layered robes of fine pale-lilac silk with crossed collars and a white inner collar, a pale gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, borders embroidered in silver thread with small moon-lamps, a silver-grey sash hung with a white jade; a white cloth bandage on the left wrist, plainly visible, with a faint dark stain at its edge. Hands and objects: a plain unglazed clay lamp with a single tiny flame and a hairline crack up its side, held in both hands; a talisman-writing brush tucked in the sash. Background: a dim shrine room with a plain wooden table and a hanging curtain, blurred, a thin veil of incense. Light: the small lamp warm on her chin from below, cold blue shadow elsewhere, a faint silver rim on her pins. Power: a thin cool blue Water haze circles the lamp and a few pale motes rise from the flame as if breathing. Expression: eyes lowered to the flame, a held-down pain in the set of her mouth. Palette: lilac, white, lamp amber, cool blue.

people.imagined: At the mouth of a freshly opened cave abode, in torchlight. He holds up a jade slip to read it and counts his money in his head; two fingers are missing from his left hand, and he says a cave took them.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a freshly opened cave abode in torchlight, he holds a jade slip up to his eyes with a hungry smile, counting his money in his head, the left hand held out; he says a cave took the two missing fingers. Face: a lean, foxy, stubbled face of about forty-five with a long nose, narrow shifting brown eyes, a sly curl to the mouth and a thin scar on the chin. Hair: black and oiled, tied back in a short tail with a bit of green cord and a bone pin, a few strands of grey-black hanging over his forehead, tacky with sweat. Body: wiry, quick, crouched, ready to run. Clothing: a dark green dust-streaked robe of good silk in two layers with crossed collars, a short travelling over-jacket of dark gauze-lined brocade, borders embroidered in dull gold thread with coiled map-lines, a belt of silk cord hung with many small pouches and a jade tassel; roguish but clearly the dress of a Trúc Cơ cultivator who has done well. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with the last two fingers plainly missing from the knuckle; the right holding a pale green jade slip close to his face; a rolled map under his arm; a small torch smoking on the wall. Background: the black mouth of a cave in a limestone massif, dark ferns, drifting cave-mist, blurred. Light: a torch from the right, orange, hard shadow, and the jade slip glowing like a cat's eye, a faint cool silver rim on his hair. Power: a thin green and dark-teal Water-and-Wood shimmer follows the jade slip and a few green motes drift up from his fingers. Expression: eyes narrowed on the jade, a sly, absorbed smile. Palette: dark green, torch orange, black.

people.imagined: Dawn at the edge of a village. He has woken, once again, barefoot with fresh mud on his heels and a rope burned round one ankle, and stands gaping as if just learning where he is.
people.subject: The moment: dawn at the edge of a village, he has woken, once again, barefoot with fresh mud on his heels and a rope burned round one ankle, and stands blinking as if just learning where he is. Face: a round, soft, slow-looking young face of about twenty with wide-set brown eyes half awake, a slightly open mouth, thick low brows, a mild puzzled look and a smear of mud on one cheek. Hair: tousled brown, a cowlick at the crown standing up like a tuft of grass, a straw stuck in it. Body: broad-shouldered, soft, loose-limbed; his shoulders sag and one knee is slightly bent, his weight leaning toward the village as if he had not quite finished walking. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of a junior disciple, a long robe of pale undyed silk with a crossed collar and a faint second layer of grey at the neck, loosely belted with a cord, sleeves a little long, one thin border of dark blue cloud-curls at the cuffs; bare feet. Hands and objects: a rope tied round the left ankle, the skin burned red under it, the rope end trailing on the grass; fresh mud on both heels; a small dull jade pendant on a cord. Background: a misty village with thatched roofs and a dawn sky, a thin line of houses with smoking chimneys, a low wall of stacked stones and a lone crow on a post, blurred. Light: pale cool dawn light from the upper left, a weak sun just clearing the roofs and laying long blue shadows across the wet grass, a soft silver rim on his hair. Power: a very faint dark blue shadow clings about his feet and drifts a little off them like breath in the cold. Expression: vague, half-awake, a mild puzzled stare at nothing. Palette: dawn grey, mud brown, pale straw.

people.imagined: At the gorge lamp, in a mood. She sits on a rock with a plait that falls to her knees, and stands on its end without noticing as she teaches or refuses to teach another child, whichever she feels like.
people.subject: The moment: at the gorge lamp, in a mood, she sits on a rock with her chin up deciding whether to answer someone, a very long plait coiled in her lap; she tilts her head as if the person before her had said something quite stupid. Face: a young, sharp, pretty face of about sixteen with a stubborn chin, wide dark eyes with a gleam, thin arched brows and a small mouth in a half-smile of mischief. Hair (most important: the plait): a single black plait of astonishing length, thick as a wrist, hanging past her knees and gathered in coils on her lap, never cut, tied with a bit of red thread, and a small jade clasp near the crown. Body: small, slender, straight, a girl's quick shoulders; her bare foot rests on the end of the plait. Clothing: a clean grey-green robe of fine silk with a crossed collar and a second paler layer, short wide sleeves, borders embroidered with tiny silver lamp-flames, a cord belt with a small jade bead; the simple graceful dress of a young disciple. Hands and objects: in her hand a single silver needle; on her lap the coils of the plait. Background: a dark gorge with a small lamp on a ledge, drifting mist, blurred. Light: warm small lamp light from the lower left making the red thread glow and picking out the loose fine hairs at her temples, a soft silver rim on her cheek. Power: a faint violet shadow trails round the needle with a few dim motes. Expression: eyes bright with scorn and amusement, one corner of the mouth lifted. Palette: black, grey-green, lamp gold, violet.

people.imagined: A ford at dusk, a young traveller with a letter in an oilcloth, writing a name on the back and watching the ink dance from the tremor in his thumb. He does not look at the river.
people.subject: The moment: a ford at dusk, a young traveller with a letter in an oilcloth sits on a stone writing a name on the back, watching the ink dance from the tremor in his thumb; he does not look at the river. Face: a thin, careful, pale young face of about twenty-two with a long jaw, level dark eyes, narrow brows, a thin set mouth and a slow considering look. Hair: dark brown, parted and tied back in a short tail with a green-brown ribbon, a few strands escaped over his temple. Body: tall, narrow, held tightly; he sits very upright with his knees together and his left hand steadying his right wrist. Clothing: a neat travel robe of dark green-brown silk with two crossed collars, narrow sleeves under a light outer gauze, borders embroidered with small leaf-sprigs in a paler thread, a silk belt with a small herb pouch and a jade bead, a satchel strap across the chest; clean and carefully mended, a junior's graceful dress. Hands and objects: the right hand holding a brush whose tip trembles; in the left a letter wrapped in oilcloth and tied with wax string. Background: a shallow ford, grey water and reeds, a line of poplars on the far bank and a faint lantern on a ferry post, a dusk sky, blurred. Light: cool dusk light from the upper left, the last blue light giving a cold edge to his forehead and the paper. Power: a faint brown-green Wood glimmer rises from the herb pouch and one or two pale motes hang over the ink. Expression: eyes narrowed on the shaking brush, a slow thin-lipped concentration. Palette: green-brown, dusk grey, a little ink black.

people.imagined: The outer gate in winter. A fur-seller's daughter in a pink robe worn thin at the cuffs, a smile on her face, tucks a letter into her sleeve and does not look at the person she has just betrayed.
people.subject: The moment: at the outer gate in winter, a fur-seller's daughter stands smiling warmly with a bundle of furs on her arm, slipping a letter into her sleeve and not looking at the person she has just betrayed. Face: a soft, round, pretty face of about thirty with rosy cheeks, large friendly brown eyes, a button nose and a small curved mouth, the smile just a shade too steady. Hair: dark brown, in two braids pinned up with pink silk ribbons and a pair of small pearl pins. Body: plump, soft and brisk, shoulders rounded forward, her weight on one foot in a warm inviting lean toward the person she speaks to. Clothing: layered robes of pale pink silk with crossed collars and soft cuffs, a darker rose sash, long sleeves, a short white-fur-trimmed jacket of white brocade, borders embroidered with small plum blossoms in silver thread; on the left forearm a cuff seam re-stitched in a slightly different shade of pink, and fur hairs clinging to every sleeve. Hands and objects: a bundle of white and silver furs on the right arm; the left hand sliding a folded paper into the sleeve; a small pink silk purse; one white fur hair across the back of her hand. Background: gate posts with a thin crust of ice and a few icicles, a wooden bucket by the wall, a woman in grey passing at a distance, a haze of falling snow, blurred. Light: cold white winter light from the upper left with a pearl-blue rim, the pink glowing, snow glare making her skin pale and pink. Power: a very faint dark-teal Water shadow lies in the folded sleeve and a single pale mote of frost drifts by. Expression: a warm, bright smile that does not reach the eyes, the gaze slid aside. Palette: pink, fur white, winter grey.

people.imagined: A wet street at night in Thu Trì. He whistles through his teeth, looking up at a window, his eyes resting on the neck of a stranger passing in the lane, reckoning a price.
people.subject: The moment: a wet street at night in Thu Trì, he stands whistling through his teeth and looking up at a window, his eyes resting on the neck of a stranger passing in the lane, reckoning a price. Face: a thin, sharp-featured boy's face of about eighteen with a long narrow nose, small bright black eyes with an unblinking flatness, pale lips pursed to whistle and a thin chin. Hair: black, wet, plastered across the forehead, a short tail tied with a red-brown cord. Body: thin and quick, hands in his sleeves, a hunched street slouch with his weight on the back foot like a cat. Clothing: a dark red-brown robe of good silk with a high crossed collar and a second soot-grey layer at the neck, narrow sleeves, borders embroidered with small black bell-flowers, dark trousers a little too big, a cord belt; clean and graceful. Hands and objects: one hand hidden in its sleeve, the other holding a paper lantern with a plain round face of dull yellow and a single black rib showing, a thin line of rainwater running down its handle; the small bronze bell at his belt wrapped in cloth. Background: a narrow wet lane of dark inns, a hung lantern, doors with lit paper windows, one half open on a dim room, a dog sleeping under an awning, blurred. Light: lantern light from the lower left with a yellow reflection on the wet stones, puddles streaking long wobbling gold, a faint cold rim on his cheek. Power: a faint steel-grey Metal glint at the wrapped bell and a hint of cold motes in the rain. Expression: a flat, bored, measuring stare at the unseen passer-by. Palette: soot, russet, lamp-gold.

people.imagined: Dawn on the peak, a young man with a broom, sweeping the same stone step he has swept every morning, in a duellist's stance he cannot help. A pale scar like a drawn string goes round his neck.
people.subject: The moment: dawn on the peak, a young man sweeps the same stone step he has swept every morning with a long broom, but his feet are in a duellist's stance he cannot help. Face (most important: a pale scar round the neck like a drawn string): a lean, hard, honest young face of about twenty-four with a strong chin, level dark eyes, straight brows and a wide plain mouth; a pale, thin scar circles the whole neck like a string, clear above the collar. Hair: black, short and unevenly cut, held by a plain iron-grey ribbon. Body: lean, strong, a duellist's balance, the broom held like a sword. Clothing: a short-collared robe of grey-brown silk in two layers with crossed collars, high at the neck, the sleeves tied back with silk cord, borders embroidered with narrow silver sword-lines, a belt and dark trousers; clean, neat and graceful, the dress of a young disciple. Hands and objects: both hands on a long broom of twigs, the grip like a sword hilt; a long plain sabre in a black scabbard leaning on the wall beside him. Background: a cold stone step, a cliff edge, a pink dawn sky and a drift of cloud, blurred. Light: cold pink dawn light from the upper left, the first sun lighting the pale scar round his neck like a drawn thread of silver. Power: a faint cold grey-silver Metal glint runs along the scabbard and a few silver motes drift off the broom. Expression: eyes level and steady on the stone, a set jaw, no pride in it. Palette: iron grey, dawn pink, stone.

people.imagined: At a desert well before a crossing. She drinks from a small cup and lifts her face to the dawn, her red-rimmed eyes unable to close and her lips cracked white, ready to ride three days without sleep.
people.subject: The moment: at a desert well before a crossing at dawn, she lowers a small cup from her lips and looks wildly up, ready to ride three days without sleep. Face (most important: red-rimmed eyes and white-cracked lips): a sun-dark, wiry, wide-cheeked face of about thirty with round dark eyes whose red rims never quite close, lips cracked into white seams, a strong nose and a streak of dust. Hair: black, tied back in a twist under a sand-coloured silk scarf, a loose strand, fine grey dust powdering the scarf and her eyebrows. Body: lean, hard and jittery, a rider's bowed stance, one knee bent and her upper body twisted toward the camel, the over-alert stance of someone who has not slept. Clothing: a short riding robe of sand-brown silk with crossed collars, a scarf of pale gauze at the neck, wide riding trousers, a red silk sash, borders embroidered with small gold dune-curves; clean, sound and graceful. Hands and objects: a small dark cup in the right hand with a red drop at the rim; the left on the rope of a camel at her side. Background: several camels kneeling in a ring round a stone-curbed well, sacks and water-skins piled between them, and far off the first line of red dunes in a rising sun, blurred. Light: cold gold dawn from the left, the low sun laying long violet shadows from each camel, a pale rim on her scarf. Power: a faint red Fire flush glows in the cup and a few red-gold motes drift up from her hand. Expression: wide-eyed, over-bright, thirsty, a gaze that never rests. Palette: sand, red, dust grey.

people.imagined: The bottom of a half-dug well in Đàm Ảnh Thành, mud to the elbow. He looks up the shaft at the circle of sky, wiping his palm, believing the old man he digs for is only a water-finder.
people.subject: The moment: the bottom of a half-dug well in Đàm Ảnh Thành, mud to the elbow, he looks up the shaft at the circle of sky and wipes his palm on his thigh, believing the old man he digs for is only a water-finder. Face: a plain, round, honest young face of about twenty-five with earnest brown eyes, thick brows, a short nose, a wide mouth ready to smile and grey earth smeared on one cheek. Hair: black and cropped, grey earth dried in it like a cap. Body: stocky and strong-armed, earth-grey from fingertips to elbows, feet apart on the muddy floor and head tipped back, hands loose. Clothing: a short sleeveless over-jacket of plain undyed silk over a clean pale shirt with a crossed collar, rolled trousers, a rope belt with a small jade bead, one border of faint teal wave-curls at the hem; clean at the collar and graceful in cut, a servant's dress kept neat. Hands and objects: forearms earth-grey to the elbow; a ring-shaped rope scar round the right palm clearly visible as he raises it; a short spade leaning on the wall with a small cloth flag tied to it. Background: a circular wall of wet earth and stone, rope and wooden rungs climbing it, a bucket on a rope from above, a little water gleaming at the bottom, a round bright sky overhead, blurred. Light: a bright spirit-light shaft from above and the upper left making a hard bright circle at his feet and a soft gold glow up his front, the rest dark and damp. Power: a faint teal-blue Water glint wakes on the wet wall and one or two cool motes drift in the shaft. Expression: an open, hopeful look up at the light. Palette: earth grey, wet brown, sky blue.

people.imagined: A river landing in the afternoon. She stands at the water's edge with her thumb held up to the light, so a fleck of gold shows in its web, thinking of the woman in the red robe and how she would stand.
people.subject: The moment: a river landing in the afternoon, she stands at the water's edge with her thumb held up to the light so that a fleck of gold shows in its web, thinking of the woman in the red robe and how she would stand. Face: a young, tanned, narrow face of about twenty with high cheekbones, big dark ambitious eyes, thick straight brows, a wide proud mouth and a smear of river mud on the chin. Hair: black, in two thick braids tied with red silk string. Body: slim, strong, straight-backed, a gold-washer's shoulders; one foot in front of the other in the shallows, hip cocked, head tilted back to follow the thumb. Clothing: a short robe of dark indigo silk, clean, with a crossed collar and a paler layer at the neck, sleeves rolled to the elbow, borders embroidered with tiny gold waves, a cord belt, trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet in the water; graceful, if plain. Hands and objects: the thumb held up with a small bright fleck of gold visible in its web; in the left a shallow wooden washing pan full of dark sand with a few glints, flat scrape-marks of years of washing on its wood; a small piece of red cloth tied at the wrist. Background: a wide brown river with reeds and a landing stage, a line of small boats and fishermen on the far bank, a heron among the reeds, a hazy brown line of hills, soft mist, blurred. Light: low golden afternoon light from the upper left with glitter on the water, catching the gold fleck so it flares like a tiny star, a soft rim on her cheek. Power: a faint pale-blue Water shimmer rides the river around her ankles and a few cool motes follow her hand. Expression: a dreamy, set look upward, mouth proud. Palette: river brown, gold, indigo.
